cons.intro: Below is what each permission does, what is stored and what happens if it's off. Changes may ask you to sign in again.
cons.core_learning.what: Needed to use TutorFren. Your child's answers and progress are saved so the tutor knows what's learned and picks the right next lesson.
cons.core_learning.stored: Stored: nickname, class, language, answers, written explanations and progress. Never a full name, address or photo.
cons.core_learning.off: This can't be switched off. To stop completely, delete the child's account.
cons.voice_input.what: Your child can answer by speaking. Speech is turned into text, which your child can check and edit.
cons.voice_input.stored: Recordings are never stored: they're deleted from the phone and the server as soon as the text is made. Only the text is kept.
cons.voice_input.off: When off, the microphone button is hidden and your child types instead.
cons.guardian_view.what: You see a summary of your child's progress in this app: what's mastered, what needs practice and which days they learned.
cons.guardian_view.stored: You never see conversations, answers or a minute-by-minute log, only the summary.
cons.guardian_view.off: When off, the dashboard shows no progress; learning carries on as normal.
cons.pilot_research.what: Your child's results are included in our study of whether TutorFren really helps children learn.
cons.pilot_research.stored: Only scores and progress are used, without any name or guardian details. Never voice.
cons.pilot_research.off: When off, everything in the app works the same; your child just isn't included in the study. You can turn it off any time.
